item.text: I found the file is small, so I’m testing the pivot creation against a temporary copy first. That lets me validate the DataPilot configuration before touching the open workbook.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cp /home/user/Invoices.xlsx /tmp/Invoices-test.xlsx && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, uno, time, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue
from com.sun.star.sheet import DataPilotFieldOrientation, GeneralFunction
from com.sun.star.table import CellRangeAddress, CellAddress

profile = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='lo-profile-')
cmd = ['soffice','--headless','--norestore','--nodefault','--nofirststartwizard',f'-env:UserInstallation=file://{profile}','--accept=socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext']
p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
time.sleep(2)
try:
    local_ctx = uno.getComponentContext()
    resolver = local_ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
    ctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
    smgr = ctx.ServiceManager
    desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
    url = uno.systemPathToFileUrl('/tmp/Invoices-test.xlsx')
    props=[]
    doc = desktop.loadComponentFromURL(url, '_blank', 0, tuple(props))
    sheets = doc.Sheets
    if sheets.hasByName('Sheet2'):
        sheets.removeByName('Sheet2')
    sheets.insertNewByName('Sheet2', 1)
    src = CellRangeAddress(0,0,0,6,18)
    out = CellAddress(1,0,0)
    dpts = sheets.getByName('Sheet2').getDataPilotTables()
    desc = dpts.createDataPilotDescriptor()
    desc.setSourceRange(src)
    fields = desc.getDataPilotFields()
    for f in fields:
        f.Orientation = DataPilotFieldOrientation.HIDDEN
    inv = fields.getByName('Invoice No.')
    inv.Orientation = DataPilotFieldOrientation.ROW
    date = fields.getByName('Date')
    date.Orientation = DataPilotFieldOrientation.DATA
    date.Function = GeneralFunction.COUNT
    dpts.insertNewByName('Invoice_Counts', out, desc)
    doc.store()
    doc.close(True)
    print('ok')
finally:
    p.terminate(); p.wait(timeout=10)
PY
